newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's APV to sue Co-Nexus for HUF four billion.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's APV to sue Co-Nexus for HUF four billion.

text.p: Hungary's privatisation agency APV Rt announced on Friday that it will sue Co-Nexus Rt for four billion forints, the nominal value of assets Co-Nexus failed to repay APV on January 8.
APV general director Pal Szabo was quoted by official news agency MTI as saying that Co-Nexus would be ready to hand over its portfolio, the value of which is unclear.

Co-Nexus was commissioned in 1992 by APV's predecessor, the State Property Agency (AVU), to manage state-owned property worth a nominal four billion forints over a four-year period, ending on December 31, 1996.

Earlier press reports suggested the property might have been overvalued and said it was unlikely the company could pay back the amount at the expiry of its contract. Other reports raised doubts about the portfolio's management.
